glosses: To make (a state or leader under the Holy Roman Empire) into a mediate vassal rather than an immediate one, directly under the emperor; (by extension) to annex while preserving certain rights and titles.

examples.text: In all, 112 imperial Estates were mediatized or lost to France, including virtually the entire church lands east of the Rhine […].

glosses: To reduce the effect of (something) by introducing a mediating agent.
To filter (an event etc.) through the mass media; to exploit (something or someone) for media exposure; to propagandize via social media.

glosses: Faire qu’un prince, un pays, en Allemagne antérieure à la république, ne relève plus immédiatement de l’empereur.
Porter un événement à l’attention des médias.

examples.text: Ce média dominant influencerait les stratégies de production des autres médias et déterminerait l’information à médiatiser.
